summary: Leading backend + ops on FINN's distributed messaging platform. Four Nordic brands, one consolidated codebase after a near-zero-downtime migration, around 30 microservices on Kubernetes, 133M+ req/day on the largest. Championing GenAI adoption inside the team — from POC to production-shaped bets.
Open banking APIs under PSD2. Data-sharing APIs for Skatteetaten and Politi. End-to-end ownership, clean-code guidance.

Cards base product — global, millions of transactions per day. Led a team to ship a microservice in two months. ASOP + Agile lead through an Atlassian transformation. Cloud infrastructure pilot on GCP + Pub/Sub, shelved by COVID budget cuts.
Identity & access management (STIM), internal React + Spring app, GDPR document-redactor POC on Google Cloud OCR.

Distributed Agile team, 20–30 microservices, 15–20 deploys/day. In-house DevOps monitoring + deployment framework. Test-code volume exceeded production-code volume. The FINN messaging domain expertise started here.
Trained cohorts of 30–35 new joiners on core Java and J2EE. Teacher before I was an engineer.
Sprint ceremonies, user stories, code review, deploys to SIT/UAT. Functional analysis and technical documentation.
Peoplesoft ERP enrollments module, end-to-end — requirements gathering through SIT/UAT.
Designed and shipped a rules engine for student admissions and progression at one of South Africa's largest universities.
Java web solutions across mutual funds, fixed deposits, vendor management, and a CMS portal. India's first online mutual-fund trading platform is from this period.
